meta.notes: Full format against a tight par: two corrections, straight to effect.

tlog.msg: CHAPTER 1.4 — DO IT AGAIN, SLOWER (NORMAL). Enemy infantry in the open, reported grid bearing ~5500 mils from your OP. A gift. Do not waste it.
Par time for full stars: 3:30.
MET: wind from 1300 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 554, ground elev 262 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "SAWMILL" grid 235 530 (grid brg 3614) · AB1002 "CHAPEL" grid 242 564 (grid brg 6107). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages HIKE and MOVA and FAVANGO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
>>> THE JOB: Enemy infantry in the open, reported grid bearing ~5500 mils from your OP. A gift. Do not waste it.
NORTHEAST OF THE AMMO DEPOT, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.
Net is mid-transmission — your traffic is copied. Stand by.
HELLHOUND FIRES, THIS IS MUSTANG 12, ADJUST FIRE, GRID 226570, TROOPS IN THE OPEN, OVER
hellhound fires, this is mustang 12, adjust fire, grid 226570, troops in the open, over
SHEAF: OPEN (inferred) — personnel target — bursts one effective width apart.
FUZE: PD (default) — standard method of engagement — point detonating (quick).
MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES — I HAVE A SPOT REPORT FOR YOU, RELAYED FROM A COASTWATCHER WHO SPEAKS THREE WORDS OF ENGLISH. SALUTE FORMAT. STAND BY, OVER.
SIZE: SQUAD PLUS — EIGHT OR MORE DISMOUNTS. ACTIVITY: INFANTRY IN THE OPEN, NO OVERHEAD COVER. LOCATION: NORTHEAST OF THE AMMO DEPOT, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT, OVER.
MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES, ADJUST FIRE, GRID 226 570, TROOPS IN THE OPEN, OUT.
UNIT: UNIDENTIFIED. MIXED KIT, MIXED DISCIPLINE. TIME: 14 MINUTES OLD. EQUIPMENT: SMALL ARMS AND PACKS. NO VEHICLES SEEN. OVER.
MESSAGE TO OBSERVER: ONE GUN IN ADJUST, BATTERY IN EFFECT, 1 ROUND, 155 HE, FUZE PD, TARGET NUMBER ALPHA ALPHA 7001, OVER.

SPOTTING: burst 23 mils LEFT of target, spotting OVER. OT range 2481 m → OT factor 2. Deviation = mils × OT factor, to the nearest 10. Range: bracket it.

MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES — UPDATED SPOT REPORT. SIZE UNCHANGED. ACTIVITY: DISPERSING AND GOING TO GROUND. LOCATION: NORTHEAST OF THE AMMO DEPOT, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT. RE-ACQUIRE AND SEND YOUR CORRECTION, OVER.
Be advised, MUSTANG — they are dispersing. Every round you spend walking is a man of theirs finding a hole. Get on with it.
RIGHT 50, DROP 150, FIRE FOR EFFECT, OUT.
Bracket established. Cut your correction in half each round from here and you will be in effect before I finish this cigarette.
